terra.problem: The punchline calls the most holy remainder of the offering leftovers and jokes about torching it. Holy things are not the joke.
The explanation says leaven and honey do not go up on the altar at all. Verse 12 specifies that they must not go up as a pleasing aroma.
Saying the only prohibition is the altar leaves out the verse's qualification: they must not go up on the altar as a pleasing aroma.
Saying the baker didn't even blink claims knowledge of the individual baker that Papa Dorin has not been given.
